content:
Excited to share that from tomorrow, 23 September 2026, I'm starting something new! 👀

From 23 September to 21 December 2026, I have planned 3 new 30-day series:

💻 1. 30 Days of Digital Skills
23 September – 22 October

🌍 2. 30 Days of Real-World Learning
23 October – 21 November

⚡ 3. 30 Days of Productivity Experiments
22 November – 21 December

And after my CA Intermediate May 2027 exams, I'm planning:

📈 4. 30 Days of LinkedIn Experiments
June 2027 👀

June has 30 days, so another complete 30-day series!

And this time, I'm keeping one thing simple:

How many impressions I get, I won't keep checking. 👀

How many reactions I get, I won't keep checking.

How many comments I get, I won't keep checking.

I'll simply post, learn, experiment, and move on to the next day.

No obsessing over numbers.
No waiting for a post to perform.
Just posting and continuing the series. 🌱

I'm just sharing this here and documenting the journey. 🙂

Also, my existing series CA + LIFE is already running. 🌱

13 days completed.
17 days remaining.

30 days. 30 lessons. One journey. ❤️

Let's see where these new series take me. 👀

#LinkedIn #LinkedInJourney #Learning #DigitalSkills #Productivity #PersonalGrowth #CALIFE
